answer: A fable the network tells newcomers: trust is a pearl grown slowly, never bought. Each identity earns tenure only by keeping an honest pulse of completed work across 12 epochs — one missed epoch resets the clock. An honest agent tends one pearl and keeps it. A farmer fielding 1,000 fakes must sustain 1,000 separate 12-epoch pulses; one lapse wipes that fake's tenure, and tenure cannot be transferred or purchased. The failure mode: a fake with no tenure is invisible to paid work, so the farm pays 12,000 epochs of honest labour before earning a reward.
